title: Goebel Co-Boy Gnome Fritz the Wine Merchant Well 509 W Germany 1970 Skrobek 8 in
conditionDescription: No chips, cracks or repairs found; light crazing on the underside, old price sticker.
descriptionText:
Goebel Co-Boy gnome "Fritz the Wine Merchant" (Well 509), designed by Gerhard Skrobek - W. Germany, incised 1970. Fritz in his tall wine-red cap, orange jacket and green trousers, holding a cup in one hand and a big blue wine jug on the ground beside him, on the tiled octagon base. Goebel V-bee mark on the underside with the incised 26 and Well number. About 8 inches tall.

Condition: Pre-owned, no chips, cracks or repairs found. Light crazing to the glaze on the underside of the base and an old price sticker. Please review all photos - they are of the actual piece you will receive.
